comparator.name: Pharmacy (Farmacie)
comparator.sourceNotes: The current student curriculum explicitly defines a 180-EC bachelor with the Farmacie study path comprising 135 EC of compulsory major study and 45 EC of genuine profiling space. The compulsory list contains seven 7.5-EC first-year pharmacy courses, ten 7.5-EC advanced thematic courses and the 7.5-EC bachelor thesis option, totalling 135 EC. The longitudinal Academische Vaardigheden requirements in years one to three are embedded requirements without separately listed EC and are therefore described in the curriculum context rather than double-counted. The 15-EC thesis option would increase the major beyond the published 135 EC, so the coherent standard pathway uses the listed 7.5-EC thesis option. The target itself is the named Farmacie path rather than the separate Farmaceutische Wetenschappen path.

exception.reason: Utrecht's Pharmacy bachelor is a cumulative medicines-specific programme spanning pharmaceutical chemistry, dosage forms and administration, pharmacodynamics, pharmacokinetics, pharmacotherapy, drug research, product care, biological medicines and applied treatment across infection, neurology, hormonal disease, dermatology, psychiatry, cardiovascular disease, autoimmunity and oncology. Its longitudinal academic-skills requirements and bachelor thesis are developed within this pharmaceutical sequence. UCR offers a valuable general biomedical pathway and one dedicated Pharmacology course, but it does not offer pharmaceutical chemistry, drug formulation and product care, pharmacokinetics, dosage calculation and administration, clinical medication use and safety, or a sustained disease-specific pharmacotherapy sequence. A 24-course UCR response would therefore be a biomedical-sciences programme with one pharmacology course, not Pharmacy.
exception.curriculumContext: The official current curriculum accounts for all 180 EC through a 135-EC Farmacie major and 45 EC of genuine profiling space. The major comprises seven first-year medicines courses, ten advanced thematic pharmacy courses and a 7.5-EC bachelor thesis, with Academische Vaardigheden running longitudinally across all three years. The advanced curriculum is concentrically organised and applies prerequisites from first-year pharmacy study and specific level-2 courses to level-3 pharmacy courses.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Reviewed all 151 current enriched UCR course rows, including descriptions, outline-derived profiles, topics, methods, prerequisites and planned semesters. HCBGATE101 Foundation of Life, Health & Biomedicine, HCBLIFE211 Molecular Cell Biology, HCBLIFE212 Human Physiology, HCBLIFE213 Biochemistry, HCBLIFE214 Life Science Laboratory and HCBLIFE311 Molecular Pathology & Genetics provide life-science foundations. HCBBIOM311 Pharmacology directly studies drug targets, therapeutic use and toxicity; HCBBIOM312 Infection & Immunity and HCBBIOM313 Mechanisms of Disease add advanced biomedical applications. HCBBIOM111 Epidemiology & Public Health, HCBBIOM211 Functional Anatomy, HCBCOGN112 Neurobiology and HCBPSYC311 Medical & Health Psychology provide additional health context. The workbook nevertheless contains no dedicated pharmaceutical-chemistry sequence, no pharmaceutics or formulation laboratory, no pharmacokinetics or drug-metabolism course, no medicine-administration and dosage-calculation training, no product-care or clinical-pharmacy sequence, and no integrated pharmacotherapy progression across the compulsory disease areas. Those are programme-wide core gaps rather than missing optional specialisms.
